evidence: Carries the Validation label and fundamentally restructures error signaling across `src/validation.cpp`, `src/node/blockstorage.cpp`, and `src/consensus/validation.h`.
rationale: Removes the `M_ERROR` runtime error state from `ValidationState`, decoupling unexpected disk/memory failures from consensus validity across `ConnectBlock`, `AcceptBlock`, and `ActivateBestChain`. This resolves a long-standing architectural hazard where callers had to disentangle fatal errors from block invalidity and paves the way for #35570.
